WITH SOURCE_CNT AS (
    SELECT count(1) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND periodstartdate = (select max(periodstartdate) from BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  )
)
, TARGET_CNT AS (
    SELECT count(1) CNT FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
    WHERE BUSINESSDATESK = (select convert(varchar,max(periodstartdate),112) from BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  )
)

SELECT CNT AS SOURCE_CNT FROM SOURCE_CNT
UNION ALL
SELECT CNT AS TARGET_CNT FROM TARGET_CNT

SELECT TABLE_NAME, 
COLUMN_NAME, 
CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'nvarchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'varchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'numeric' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'decimal' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime','datetime2', 'date', 'int', 'bigint', 'tinyint', 'float', 'smallint','bit','time') THEN DATA_TYPE
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'bit' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')'
	 END AS DATA_TYPE,
	 LEFT(IS_NULLABLE,1) IS_NULLABLE			 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20240104_day1') and TABLE_SCHEMA = 'busc'
ORDER BY 1


select 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 where h = 'd' 
UNION ALL
select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20240104_day1


SELECT COUNT(1) null_cnt from (
SELECT * from busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20240104_day1 WHERE
 ACID IS NULL OR
 EOD_DATE IS NULL OR
 END_EOD_DATE IS NULL OR
 TRAN_DATE_BAL IS NULL ) a


 with src as (
    select * from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 stg where h = 'd' 
    and not EXISTS (
        select * from  busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20240104_day1  
    )
), tgt as (
    select * from  busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20240104_day1 tgt

        select * from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 stg where h = 'd' 
    )
)

select 'SRC' tables, count(1) cnt from src 
union all
select 'TGT' tables, count(1) cnt from tgt

SELECT
 'STG' TABLES
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),TRAN_AMT)) AS TRAN_AMT
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),RESERVATION_AMT)) AS RESERVATION_AMT
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),FX_TRAN_AMT)) AS FX_TRAN_AMT
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),REF_AMT)) AS REF_AMT
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),REGULARIZATION_AMT)) AS REGULARIZATION_AMT
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT)) AS PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM)) AS USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM)) AS USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT)) AS USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT
FROM d360.STG_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_TEST_20230607 where h = 'd' 
UNION ALL
SELECT
 'TGT' TABLES
,SUM(TRAN_AMT) AS TRAN_AMT
,SUM(RESERVATION_AMT) AS RESERVATION_AMT
,SUM(FX_TRAN_AMT) AS FX_TRAN_AMT
,SUM(REF_AMT) AS REF_AMT
,SUM(REGULARIZATION_AMT) AS REGULARIZATION_AMT
,SUM(PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT) AS PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT
,SUM(USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM) AS USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
,SUM(USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM) AS USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
,SUM(USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT) AS USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT
FROM  busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_CM230_20231215_day1
